resources.string: RouteMock simulates location for education, development, and authorized testing. Please read each document. These are drafts pending legal review.
I accept the Responsible Use and Terms
I have read the Privacy Notice
Optional: allow dashboard pairing and data upload
Some consent from before is still in place. You can withdraw it here.
Withdrawing a required consent stops any running simulation and returns to this setup. Past records stay in your receipt.
Not connected. RouteMock works fully without a dashboard.
Allow dashboard pairing above to connect.
Off by default. Each request still needs your approval here. Stop always works locally.
Dashboard problem (%1$d). Simulation is not affected.
Your dashboard asks to start draft version %1$d (%2$s, %3$s, %4$s). Only approve a request you expect.
Movement follows the direct path between the two points, ignoring roads, buildings, water, and terrain.
Straight-line distance %1$s, about %2$s at this speed
A simulation is running. Changes here apply the next time you start one.
Enter a plain decimal number, such as 37.7749
Speed must be at most 1200 km/h (about 745 mph)
Start and destination are the same point
A straight-line route needs two different points. To stay in one place, use Stationary mode.
Start and destination are on opposite sides of the Earth
No single straight-line path exists between these points. Choose a different destination.
Mock location sends simulated positions to the device. Preview only moves the numbers on this screen.
In-app preview: nothing is sent to the device
Other apps still see your real location. Use Start mock location to inject positions.
Sending simulated positions to test providers: %1$s. Android marks them as mock, and whether another app uses them depends on that app.
On arrival, jump back to the start and run again
RouteMock selected as mock location app
In Settings, open About phone and tap Build number seven times to enable Developer options. Then open Developer options, tap Select mock location app, and choose RouteMock.
Device location is off, so apps will not receive these positions until it is turned on.
Fix the route first. Open the Route section to see what needs attention.
RouteMock is not the selected mock location app
Allow notifications to start. While mock location runs, its Pause and Stop controls stay in a notification.
Mock location stopped and test providers removed
Apps may keep showing the last simulated position until the device gets a new real fix. That can take a while, especially indoors.
Android refused to remove one or more test providers, so apps may not get real locations. Select RouteMock as the mock location app again and reopen RouteMock, or restart the phone.
RouteMock is not authorized to provide mock locations
Mock location stopped because of an error: %1$s
The previous simulation ended without Stop and was not restarted

This happens after a force-stop or a crash. Android does not let an app clean up then, so the test providers stayed registered until RouteMock opened just now. They have been removed. Apps may keep showing the last simulated position until the device gets a new real fix.
No saved routes yet. Fill in the Route section and tap Save route.
Could not read or write saved routes on this device.
The saved routes file was unreadable, so it was set aside and the list started empty.
Follows road geometry from a routing service. Calculate and choose a route in the Map section. If no route is available, nothing is substituted.
No road route selected. Calculate and choose one in the Map section.
The pins moved after this road route was calculated. Calculate again in the Map section.
Road route %1$s, about %2$s at the selected speed
Road mode needs a calculated route for the current pins. Calculate and choose one in the Map section. Straight line is available as a separate mode.
Road route without stored geometry. Load it and calculate again.
Calculating sends your start and destination coordinates to %1$s.
Place start and destination pins at two different points first.
The pins moved, so these routes no longer apply. Calculate again.
No road was found near a pin. Move the pin closer to a road.
No drivable route joins these pins.
These pins are too far apart for this routing service.
The routing service is limiting requests. Wait a moment and try again.
The routing service could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.
The routing service took too long to answer. Try again.
A secure connection to the routing service could not be made, so nothing was accepted. Check the phone\'s date and network.
The routing service tried to redirect the request, which RouteMock does not follow.
The configured routing address is not a valid HTTPS address, so nothing was sent.
The routing service reported an error. Try again later.
The routing service sent a response RouteMock could not read.
No route was selected. RouteMock does not switch to a straight line by itself. Straight line is a separate mode.
The distance-only search failed, so fewer routes were compared.
Shortest and fastest estimate of returned routes
Compared only among the routes returned. Not a guarantee of the shortest or fastest route on the road network.
Longer alternative: at most %1$d%% extra distance
Every longer route returned exceeds the %1$d%% limit.
The longer routes returned are too similar to the shortest.
The longer routes returned repeat part of their path, so none are offered.
Road start is %1$s from your start pin
Road end is %1$s from your destination pin
Selecting a route changes the draft only. Start it from the Simulation section.
Playback uses your selected speed, not the estimated travel time.
Traffic from %1$s is stale, last updated %2$s
Tap the map to place the start pin
Tap the map to place the destination pin
Tap the map to place the stationary pin
Choose what to place, then tap the map. Pins can also be dragged.
Pins change the draft only. The running simulation is not affected. Changes apply the next time you start one.
Place both pins to see distance and duration
While mock location runs, Android replaces the real providers, so this may not update until you stop.
Allow location to show your real position on the map. Mock location works without it.
Location permission denied. There is no real-location marker, and delivery cannot be observed. The map, pins, and simulation still work.
Simulator intends: %1$s, %2$s. This is the simulator\'s own position, not proof of delivery.
Preview position: %1$s, %2$s. Nothing is sent to the device.
Android delivered a mock-flagged fix to RouteMock %1$s ago, %2$s from the intended position.
Last mock-flagged fix from Android was %1$s ago. Delivery may have stopped.
No delivery observed yet. Android has not returned a mock-flagged fix to RouteMock.
Delivery cannot be observed without location permission.
Offline. Map tiles are unavailable, but pins, coordinates, and simulation still work.
The map service could not be reached. Pins, coordinates, and simulation still work.
Some map tiles failed to load. Pins, coordinates, and simulation still work.
Shown while RouteMock supplies mock locations
